title: 实验室里的八类危害（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/13_What are lab hazards categories of lab hazards laboratory hazards laboratory haz.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/13_What are lab hazards categories of lab hazards laboratory hazards laboratory haz（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验
points.S2: 延长线临时用，不当固定线路
points.S4: 长时间移液，定时歇一歇

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现一个分成八格的彩色转盘
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a floating colorful wheel divided into eight blank segments, each with a simple icon.
shots.narration: 今天认一认实验室里的八类危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研站在实验室门口，阿杰环顾四周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands with the female graduate student at a lab entrance, looking around at benches, an autoclave, a gas cylinder and a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次来实验室打扫卫生。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 他问：这里看着挺安全，危险在哪？

shots.scene: 小研笑着指向实验台、气瓶和延长线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points to a reagent shelf, a gas cylinder and an extension cord running along a bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：危险就藏在这些东西里。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 我们先学会把它们认出来。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过实验台，台上几个物品闪出黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass sweeps over a lab bench; a few items glow with small warning triangle icons. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室危害，就是这里潜在的危险。

shots.scene: 一个平静的实验室，角落里有若隐若现的感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A calm, tidy lab with faint exclamation mark icons hidden near a shelf and a power outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 平时看不见，条件一凑齐就出事。

shots.scene: 三个图标：人、树木河流、实验台上的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: a person outline, trees with a river, and culture dishes on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 危害会伤到三样东西。

shots.scene: 人形图标被溅到液滴，旁边红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A person outline splashed by droplets, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 首先是做实验的人，

shots.scene: 污水流向河流图标，河里的鱼变灰
shots.prompt_en: A drain pipe flowing toward a river icon where the fish turn grey. No people.
shots.narration: 其次是实验室外的环境，

shots.scene: 培养皿长满杂菌，实验记录上画叉
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish overgrown with stray colonies next to a blank lab notebook marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 还有实验本身，污染了就白做。

shots.scene: 八格转盘逐格亮起，每格一个图标
shots.prompt_en: The eight-segment wheel lights up one segment at a time: a flask, a microbe, a slipping figure, a gear, a lightning bolt, a radiation trefoil, an ear, and a seated worker. No people.
shots.narration: 按来源，危害可以分成几大类。

shots.scene: 转盘继续亮起后三格
shots.prompt_en: The last three segments of the wheel glow: a radiation trefoil, an ear with sound waves, and a seated worker at a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲常见的八类。

shots.scene: 转盘外圈还有压力表和疲惫小人的淡色图标
shots.prompt_en: Around the wheel, faint extra icons of a pressure gauge and a tired stick figure appear. No people.
shots.narration: 压力设备、疲劳这些也要留心。

shots.scene: 试剂架上几瓶试剂，标签空白只有象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent shelf with bottles whose labels are blank except for hazard pictograms: flame, skull, corrosion. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类，化学危害。

shots.scene: 四个象形图并排：火焰、骷髅、腐蚀、爆炸
shots.prompt_en: Four hazard pictograms in a row: flame, skull and crossbones, corrosion, and exploding bomb. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、有毒、腐蚀、活泼的化学品，

shots.scene: 人形图标的手、眼、肺三处出现红点
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with red spots on the hand, the eyes and the lungs. No people.
shots.narration: 会灼伤皮肤，伤眼睛，伤呼吸道。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套护目镜，先看试剂瓶标签再取用
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, reads a bottle's blank pictogram label before using it.
shots.narration: 用之前，先看标签，戴好防护。

shots.scene: 培养皿和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Culture dishes next to a biohazard sign on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类，生物危害。

shots.scene: 细菌、病毒、毒素三个卡通图标
shots.prompt_en: Three cartoon icons: a rod-shaped bacterium, a round virus particle, and a small toxin droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 有感染性的细菌、病毒和毒素，

shots.scene: 人形图标打喷嚏、发烧的温度计
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with a thermometer showing fever and a tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 可能让人感染、生病。

shots.scene: 动物笼、植物盆、标着基因双螺旋的试管
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an animal cage, a potted plant, and a tube marked with a DNA double helix. No people.
shots.narration: 动物、植物、改造过的菌株也算。

shots.scene: 一组黄色警示三角：火焰、爆炸、割伤、跌倒
shots.prompt_en: A group of warning triangle icons: flame, explosion burst, cut hand, and a falling figure. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类，物理危害。

shots.scene: 破碎的玻璃器皿和湿滑的地面
shots.prompt_en: Broken glassware on a bench and a wet floor with a slipping figure icon. No people.
shots.narration: 着火、爆炸、割伤、滑倒摔跤，

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器冒热气，液氮罐冒冷雾
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave releasing steam next to a liquid nitrogen dewar releasing cold mist. No people.
shots.narration: 还有烫伤、冻伤这些极端温度，

shots.scene: 离心机转子和飞出的碎片图标
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge with an icon of small fragments flying outward, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 以及转动部件和飞溅物。

shots.scene: 老李检查离心机和摇床
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a centrifuge and a shaker on a bench.
shots.narration: 第四类，设备危害。

shots.scene: 离心机不平衡放管、盖子没盖的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an unbalanced centrifuge rotor and an open centrifuge lid, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用法不对，会出事故。

shots.scene: 一台设备冒出黑烟、指示灯闪红
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a flashing red indicator and a puff of dark smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 设备出了故障，也会伤人。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白操作卡前听小研讲解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student listens to the female graduate student explain a blank instrument instruction card.
shots.narration: 没培训过的设备，不要自己开。

shots.scene: 电气警告标志和实验台下的插座
shots.prompt_en: An electrical warning sign above a power outlet under a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类，电气危害。

shots.scene: 破皮的电线、焦黑的插头
shots.prompt_en: A frayed power cord with exposed wires and a scorched plug. No people.
shots.narration: 电线老化、设备失修，

shots.scene: 电火花引出小火苗、触电的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A spark igniting a small flame, next to a person outline with a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 会触电，也会引起火灾。

shots.scene: 老李拔下损坏的插头，贴上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs a damaged cord and hangs a blank out-of-service tag on the instrument.
shots.narration: 发现破损，停用报修，不凑合。

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志和紫外灯图标
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation trefoil sign next to an ultraviolet lamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第六类，辐射危害。

shots.scene: 射线穿过人形图标，皮肤和眼睛处发红
shots.prompt_en: Rays passing through a person outline, with red patches on the skin and eyes. No people.
shots.narration: 电离、非电离辐射都可能伤组织。

shots.scene: 王老师指着辐射工作场所门口，阿杰止步
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a door with a radiation warning sign; the young male student stops before it.
shots.narration: 有放射源的地方，须经专门培训。

shots.scene: 耳朵和声波的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle with an ear and sound waves pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 第七类，噪声危害。

shots.scene: 超声破碎仪和真空泵发出声波，人形图标捂耳朵
shots.prompt_en: An ultrasonic homogenizer and a vacuum pump emitting sound waves; a person outline covers its ears. No people.
shots.narration: 长期噪声大，会损伤听力，

shots.scene: 小研喊话，阿杰听不清，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls out in a noisy lab; the young male student cannot hear and shows a question mark.
shots.narration: 还会听不清提醒，耽误应急。

shots.scene: 一张过高的实验台和弯腰的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A person outline hunched over a bench that is too low, with a red curve on the back. No people.
shots.narration: 第八类，人机工效危害。

shots.scene: 移液枪反复按压，手腕处发红
shots.prompt_en: A pipette being pressed again and again, with a red glow at the wrist of a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工位不合适、动作总重复，

shots.scene: 颈、肩、腰、腕四处红点
shots.prompt_en: A person outline with red spots on the neck, shoulders, lower back and wrists. No people.
shots.narration: 久了颈肩腰腕都会劳损。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：手册、讲台、防护服
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: a blank manual, a classroom podium, and a lab coat with gloves.
shots.narration: 危害这么多，怎么防？

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰和学生们上安全课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a lab safety class to the young male student and other students with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 先有安全规程，再做培训，

shots.scene: 手套、护目镜、实验服、口罩四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: gloves, safety goggles, a lab coat, and a respirator mask. No people.
shots.narration: 按需要戴好个人防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰在镜子前穿好实验服、戴好手套护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a lab coat, gloves and goggles in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 防护用品，选对、穿对、用对。

shots.scene: 老李拿着空白检查表检查通风柜和灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks through the lab with a blank checklist, checking a fume hood and an autoclave.
shots.narration: 设备和设施，要定期检查。

shots.scene: 日历上每月一个对勾，旁边扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a check mark on each month next to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按时维护，有记录，

shots.scene: 王老师和老周在空白检查表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man sign a blank inspection checklist together.
shots.narration: 发现问题，及时整改。

shots.scene: 环境危害象形图：枯树和鱼
shots.prompt_en: The hazard pictogram for the environment, a bare tree and a fish inside a red diamond. No people.
shots.narration: 危害也会伤到环境。

shots.scene: 废液倒向水池，被打叉；旁边是废液收集桶
shots.prompt_en: A bottle pouring liquid into a sink, crossed out with a red X; next to it, a closed waste collection container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 废液废物不乱倒，按规定收集。

shots.section_title: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验
shots.scene: 实验室角落里用链条固定的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder secured to the wall with a chain, with a blank tag hanging on its valve. No people.
shots.narration: 转盘上的压力，也要说一说。
overlay: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验

shots.section_title: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验
shots.scene: 没固定、倒在地上的气瓶图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unsecured gas cylinder tipping over, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶要固定，防止倾倒，

shots.section_title: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验
shots.scene: 老李查看高压灭菌器上的检验标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank inspection tag on an autoclave's pressure gauge.
shots.narration: 灭菌器这类压力设备，定期检验。

shots.section_title: 气瓶固定，压力设备定期检验
shots.scene: 阿杰站在灭菌器前，小研示意持证人员操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands back from an autoclave while the female graduate student signals that only trained staff operate it by following the procedure.
shots.narration: 经培训、按规程操作，不擅自动。

shots.section_title: 延长线临时用，不当固定线路
shots.scene: 一根长延长线从门外拉进来，常年给培养箱供电，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A long extension cord runs in from the corridor and permanently powers an incubator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 原片提到延长线，用法要对。
overlay: 延长线临时用，不当固定线路

shots.section_title: 延长线临时用，不当固定线路
shots.scene: 老李在培养箱旁的墙上装好固定插座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a fixed wall outlet next to the incubator.
shots.narration: 长期用电的设备，请电工装固定插座。

shots.section_title: 延长线临时用，不当固定线路
shots.scene: 小研用完延长线，拔下盘好放回柜里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unplugs an extension cord after use, coils it neatly and puts it back in a cabinet.
shots.narration: 临时用完，拔下收好。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜里紫外灯亮着，柜前没人
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet with its ultraviolet lamp glowing violet and no one in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室最常见的是紫外灯。

shots.scene: 人形图标直视紫外灯，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person outline staring at a glowing ultraviolet lamp, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开着时人要离开，不直视，

shots.scene: 小研在门口确认无人后才按下开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the room is empty before pressing a switch by the door.
shots.narration: 开灯前确认没人，关了再进。

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，定时歇一歇
shots.scene: 小研坐在调好高度的椅子上移液，脚踏实地
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pipettes while seated on a chair adjusted to the right height, feet flat on the floor.
shots.narration: 人机工效，也有简单的办法。
overlay: 长时间移液，定时歇一歇

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，定时歇一歇
shots.scene: 计时器响起，小研起身活动肩膀
shots.prompt_en: A timer rings; the female graduate student stands up and rolls her shoulders.
shots.narration: 调好座椅台面，隔一阵起来活动，

shots.section_title: 长时间移液，定时歇一歇
shots.scene: 小研戴耳塞操作发声大的仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears ear plugs while running a loud instrument.
shots.narration: 噪声大的仪器，戴好耳塞。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着八格转盘
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the eight-segment wheel with all segments lit.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、设备，

shots.scene: 转盘后四格高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last four segments of the wheel are highlighted: lightning bolt, radiation trefoil, ear, seated worker. No people.
shots.narration: 电气、辐射、噪声、人机工效。

shots.scene: 规程、培训、防护、检查四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a blank manual, a podium, a lab coat with gloves, and a checklist with a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 规程、培训、防护、检查，一个不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白检查表，在实验室里逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks through the lab with a blank checklist, ticking items next to the gas cylinder and extension cord.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：原来危险都能认出来！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室里挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in the lab.
shots.narration: 先认危害，再动手，下次见！
